description.description: What the room is for, shown beside its label. Absent: the room has none until an administrator gives it one with vtc/rooms/community/update.

tags.description: Tags to file the room under, for administrators' filtering. Absent: none.

visibility.description: The tier, fixed for the life of the room. The community's rooms policy decides which it may create.

retentionPolicy.description: Whether the room keeps its history readable across a membership change. Immutable; absent means `chained`.

retentionDays.description: How long the room is kept after it lapses. Absent: the community's default.

storageConfig.description: The storage config to receive the room's uploads. Absent: what the community's rooms policy decides, else its default config.

Response.title: VTC Rooms Community Create — response payload
Response.description: Success response to vtc/rooms/community/create. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/rooms/community/create/0.3#response. The room as created, owned by the community.

roomProfile.description: Whether the room's own profile — its label and description, sealed inside the room for its members — has been written. `written`: the room's members can read it. `pending`: the room exists and the community has not yet written its profile — its VTA or the room's host did not answer, or refused — and will keep trying. The room is created either way.
